title: The Story of My Life
author: Helen Keller
description: Keller was twenty-two when she wrote this. The chapter where the word "water" arrives is one of the great moments in autobiography.
snippet: It is with a kind of fear that I begin to write the history of my life. I have, as it were, a superstitious hesitation in lifting the veil…
